recap.text: GumGum is a level-5 orc at the One-Eyed Narwhal with a red-stained shirt. She asks Carl for help with a pile of dead women, but Carl does not mean it when he agrees. GumGum is found dead in an alley with her chest rent open. Salvatore of the 201st Security Group tortures her for the crawlers' names.

beats.headline: I really need your help
beats.text: For the record: a woman orc drinking alone in the corner of the One-Eyed Narwhal. Older, swaying, her medieval shirt stained red, like a butcher who forgot her apron. Crawler Carl is reminded of an orcish, well-muscled Agatha. Tooltip: Level-5 Orc NPC. Name: GumGum. "I see you're adventurers. I really need your help." Mordecai: no; fuck off; not tonight. She settles back into her chair, puts her face in her hands and weeps. When Carl slips back out to ask what she needed, she is gone.
beats.gist: GumGum is a Level-5 Orc NPC and a regular at the One-Eyed Narwhal.

beats.headline: A pile outside the gates
beats.text: The next evening, outside the gates, she tosses a body onto a pile of about fifteen: humans, orcs, elves and dwarves, every one of them a woman. The system groups them as Pile of Dead Hookers. She was hoping to catch the crawlers. New ones are found in the alleys every morning, strangers to the town, most of their blood gone. The skyfowl do not care as long as the bodies go; the guards do not work at night. "These were people." Quest issued: The Sex Workers Who Fell from the Heavens. "We'll see what we can do," says Carl.
beats.gist: GumGum tosses a woman onto a pile of fifteen dead sex workers outside the gates.

beats.headline: In the alley
beats.text: GumGum, orc, level 5, is dead. Found when Crawler Donut's torch lights an alley that Mongo ran down: her chest rent open. Three disembodied female heads, organs dangling beneath them, shriek at the light and corkscrew into the dark, and a tall figure with a smoking, burning hand stands over the scene. The crawlers had seen her only a few hours before.
beats.gist: Donut's torch lights an alley where level 5 orc GumGum lies with her chest rent open.

beats.headline: Four gold and two papers
beats.text: Crawler Carl had told her they would help, and he had not meant it. Lootable Corpse. GumGum. Orc. Level 5. It does not say what killed her. A ripped-open chest and no blood suggest the flying heads. Her inventory: four gold coins, a Gate Pass, and a Mysterious Letter, blood-soaked and in an odd language nobody present can read. Crawler Donut: she was a nice lady, for an orc, and she was doing the right thing. They have to finish the quest now.
beats.gist: Carl and Donut find the lootable corpse of GumGum, a level 5 orc.

beats.headline: Fitz's best customer
beats.text: Back at the inn Crawler Donut tells Mordecai that GumGum died because of them, and they are going to make it right. Fitz the barkeep hears it: GumGum dead. His best customer. Pressed by Donut, he tells the rest. GumGum went into the alleys at night when she heard one of the fallen women, and had nightmares of one dying with nobody to hold her hand. Her own mother was a lady of the night, stabbed, who crawled home to die on the stoop, leaving a red streak half a kilometer long. Nobody helped. The nicest orc you'd ever meet.
beats.gist: Donut tells Mordecai that GumGum died because of them and they will make it right.

beats.headline: Tortured for a name
beats.text: Outside the elves' temple, Salvatore of the 201st Security Group explains. They had to torture her to tease the crawlers' name from her lips. GumGum was serving an important purpose, removing the unworthy filth from the streets. Then she started asking questions, and the questions attracted the Oak Fell, just as the Master predicted. "You tortured GumGum?" asks Crawler Donut. Yes, says Salvatore, just as they shall torture the crawlers.
beats.gist: Salvatore of the 201st Security Group tortured GumGum to learn the crawlers' name.

beats.headline: The letter was listening
beats.text: That morning the crawlers stand over a dead woman with "No you won't" carved into her, dropped on their inn the night before moments after Crawler Carl promised revenge for GumGum with her letter in his hand. Mordecai works it out. The Mysterious Letter was likely planted in her inventory for whoever investigated the deaths: a spent necroscript scroll, Suppurating Eye, soaked in the caster's blood. Out of inventory, the caster can see and hear anything near it. Crawler Donut's idea: use it as bait.
beats.gist: Crawlers find a dead woman with a letter and a blood-soaked Suppurating Eye.

beats.headline: Somebody did notice
beats.text: Remex explains why the women were brought in from out of town: the raw materials came from elsewhere, so nobody would notice his wife collecting them. Crawler Donut corrects him. "Somebody did notice. Gumgum noticed." For the record, the one who noticed asked two crawlers for help at a pub table, and was told to fuck off.
beats.gist: GumGum noticed Remex's wife collecting raw materials.
